verdict.rationale: Bento has a hosted official MCP server (mcp.bentonow.com) that lets an agent look up subscribers and work with broadcasts. Its API covers subscriber search with tag, segment and date filters, plus review of broadcast history, and the CLI manages broadcasts and sequences. That gives an agent programmatic access to audiences and campaign history. However, nothing shows an agent can read live workflow/automation state or pull per-campaign performance metrics (opens, clicks, revenue attribution) to judge what's working. missing for 10: API/MCP read access to live automations and workflows, programmatic campaign results and performance metrics, revenue attribution exposed via API, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent reporting.
